title: PDF to PowerPoint – PDF Pages to PPTX Slides, No Upload
description: Convert a PDF to PowerPoint in your browser: each page becomes a slide that looks exactly like it, or editable text boxes (beta). Nothing is uploaded.
heading: PDF to PowerPoint
subtitle: Turn each page of a PDF into a slide that looks exactly like the page, or into editable text boxes; nothing is uploaded.
intro: Convert PDF to PowerPoint online to show a report or handout in a presentation. By default every page becomes one slide holding a picture of the page, so it looks exactly like the PDF. Choose Editable text (beta) instead to get each block of text as an editable text box where it was and each picture where it sat; headings keep their size and lists their bullets, and the layout is approximate. Your file never leaves your device.

features.title: Private
features.text: Your file is handled by your own browser and never sent to a server, so nobody else sees it.

features.title: Looks exactly right
features.text: By default each slide is a picture of its page, so nothing shifts or reflows.

features.title: Editable text (beta)
features.text: Prefer to edit? Get text boxes you can click into, with the pictures where they were.

stepsTitle: How to convert PDF to PowerPoint

steps.title: Choose your PDF
steps.text: Click Choose a file, or drop a PDF on the page.

steps.title: Choose the slides
steps.text: Keep Pages as pictures for slides that look exactly like the PDF, or pick Editable text (beta).

steps.title: Download
steps.text: Download the .pptx file and open it in PowerPoint, Keynote or Google Slides.

handles: One slide per page, the size and shape of the first page.
Pages as pictures (default): each slide is a picture of its page at 200 dpi, at most 2,000 pixels on the long side, so it looks exactly like the page.
Editable text (beta): text blocks as text boxes, with size, bold, italic and bullets, and pictures where they were.
Arabic text boxes, right to left.
limits: With Pages as pictures, the text on the slides can't be edited.
Editable text is in beta: drawn shapes, lines, colours and backgrounds are left out, text boxes use Arial, and the layout is approximate.
Scanned PDFs hold pictures of pages, so Editable text finds no text to convert (that needs OCR).
PDFs that need a password to open must be unlocked first, with Unlock PDF.

faq.question: Is my file uploaded?
faq.answer: No. Your file is read and changed by your own browser, on your device, and is never sent anywhere. You can check it: open your browser's network panel while you use the tool and you will see no upload.

faq.question: Can I edit the text on the slides?
faq.answer: With Editable text (beta), yes: every block of text is a normal PowerPoint text box. With the default, Pages as pictures, each slide is a picture of its page, so the text can't be edited.

faq.question: Why are some shapes or backgrounds missing?
faq.answer: That happens with Editable text (beta): only text and pictures are carried over, and drawn shapes, lines and backgrounds are left out. Pages as pictures keeps everything, because each slide is a picture of the whole page.

faq.question: Does it work with scanned PDFs?
faq.answer: Yes, with Pages as pictures, which shows each scanned page as it is. Editable text needs text in the file; a scan holds only pictures, so it needs text recognition first, which OCR PDF does.

faq.question: I only need the pages as pictures, not a presentation. What can I use?
faq.answer: PDF to JPG saves each page as a picture file.

faq.question: Is it really free?
faq.answer: Yes. There is no account, no watermark and no limit on how often you use it.

faq.question: How do I convert a PDF to PowerPoint?
faq.answer: Turn each PDF page into a slide, then open the .pptx in PowerPoint, Keynote or Google Slides. OpenAnyDoc's PDF to PowerPoint does it in your browser: choose the PDF, keep Pages as pictures for slides that look exactly like the pages or pick Editable text (beta) for text boxes, click Convert to PowerPoint and download, with nothing uploaded.
